subject: Invitation to Our Annual Charity Gala
body: Dear valued supporter, We are excited to invite you to our upcoming Annual Charity Gala benefiting children in need. Join us for a night of elegance and philanthropy on Saturday, December 12th, at the Grand Ballroom. Your attendance will make a meaningful impact on the lives of those we serve. Please RSVP by November 30th. We look forward to seeing you there! Warm regards, The Charity Foundation Team
